docs.title: Welcome to My Portfolio
docs.text: Hello there and welcome to my portfolio! I'm Angela Ferguson, a technical writer specializing in clear, engaging documentation for complex systems.

docs.title: Featured Projects
docs.text:
• API Documentation: Sample REST API docs with detailed code examples.
  • User Guide: A guide that I wrote from scratch for a completely new product.
  • Documentation revamp: An existing section of documentation that I revamped to improve flow, accessibility, and fill in some gaps.

docs.title: About Me
docs.text:
Based in Toronto, I've been working as a technical content developer at Dayforce for over 10 years. I enjoy making technical information accessible and elegant. I have experience writing user guides, release notes, and API documentation. I developed and continue to maintain the internal Dayforce Technical Writing Style Guide. I've been enjoying experimenting with AI tools and how they can help me do my job.

This portfolio was built using MkDocs and the Material for MkDocs theme.
